service:
[Unit]
Description=Canonfig follower synchronization

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart="/opt/Canonfig Tools/canonfig" "sync" "--apply" "--no-input"
schedule:
[Unit]
Description=Canonfig follower synchronization schedule

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 01:30:00 America/New_York
Persistent=true
Unit=canonfig-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
